descriptionChirho: The proper noun referring to Teman, a region or city in Edom associated with Esau's descendants (Gen 36) and referenced in prophetic oracles against Edom (Jer 49, Ezek 25, Amos 1, Obad, Hab 3). All four clusters are the same toponym with different prepositional frames (bare, min 'from,' beth 'in,' construct). Spanish consistently renders 'Tecoa/Temán,' Arabic uses 'تَيْمان/تَقوعَ,' Hindi uses 'तेमान,' Korean uses '데만,' and Swahili uses 'Temani.' These are purely grammatical variants of one proper noun referent.
